After such a banner year, where among other things, Bitcoin hit all-time highs above $100,000, it really should be no surprise that our Web3 team thinks there's a lot to come next year.
So if you'd like to stay up to date with all things Web3 and the next generation of the internet, check out Web3 with A16C.
